correctness.rationale: Difference of heat rows remains symmetric on other clique vertices; four-variable ODE is obtained by vertex-wise Laplacian action. Metzler irreducibility yields positivity u,v,w,z and the two-dimensional difference mode positivity. Bridges force costs u and v and residual positive A-clique source w, yielding transport primal u+v+w; 1-Lipschitz potential saturates all spanning edges and ensures uniqueness. Diagonalizing c=p,p-2 sectors gives four exponentials; Taylor coefficients p-3 and 6-p^2 give threshold, and logarithmic time scaling gives limit 2. Independently computed expm of full graph Laplacian at p=3,4,5,8 and t=.01,.17,.9; Kantorovich witness matched stated expression to <1e-10. These are only corroborating cases.
